acceptance_designs.scenario: Run the exact portable image on a clean qualified host offline; observe no undeclared runtime acquisition or extraction.
Run console-only commands with no GUI framework present and audit imports/static initialization.
Compare finalized portable bytes against extracted and installed product payloads.
Reject package construction cycles, self-containing final carriers and recursive final-image hashes.
Replace staged setup host, source executable or reviewed package; refuse before effects.
Trace files-only deployment and removal; refuse undeclared host integration; retain unknown files.
Detect a pre-existing tool; prove repair/update/remove do not silently take ownership.
Resolve incompatible component choices with explanations; never silently install a driver or GUI.
With networking prohibited, return an explicit missing-source result without fallback.
Change provider identity after review; invalidate the operation plan.
Attempt servicing while storage work/recovery depends on an old image; retain or defer.
Ensure USK does not directly replace MSI/MSIX-owned resources.
Compare semantic plans/results through machine and interactive presentations; machine mode never prompts.
Upgrade a console-only installation while preserving exclusions, scope and approved channel policy.
Inject interruption at declared lifecycle boundaries; retain truthful recovery dispositions.
Audit exact imports, CPU and runtimes; run on declared old hosts, not only a current compatibility layer.
Qualify terminal I/O, redirection and exit status separately from a rendered text window.
Attempt an unadmitted plugin load/elevation; deny and report the actual enforced boundary.
Reject mutation when a required format feature is unknown or unqualified.
Validate offline/silent/immutable installer and applicable driver restrictions before submission.
Start with corrupted nonessential settings, unavailable optional modules and no networking. Preserve policy and expose built-in diagnostics.
One device denies access, another provider stalls, another succeeds; retain successful identity-bound observations and explicit omissions.
Simulate a driver that does not complete cancellation; do not claim quiescence, retry mutation or unload required recovery state.
Nested malicious containers, cycles and huge counts respect memory/CPU/output bounds; reject invalid ranges.
Replace selected media after planning; execution must not follow a reused drive number or display row.
Keyboard, focus, contrast and accessibility workflows produce the same semantic plans and outcomes as CLI.
Recovery on another partition of the same failing device is not represented as an independent backup.
Scope-specific PATH changes are opt-in; uninstall preserves unrelated subsequent edits and foreign shortcuts/files.
Update/uninstall cannot retire an exact provider generation required by ongoing storage or unresolved recovery.
No remote listener is enabled by SDK installation; unauthorized or uncertain shared-storage control cannot trigger writes.
Sequential tape marks, partitions and position uncertainty are not treated as ordinary disk extents.
Every bundled dependency has an approved exact licence/provenance record; unresolved original-code licensing is visible.
A constrained legacy executor refuses unknown required operations/features rather than trusting a modern coordinator plan blindly.
